text:
alex: Hit a surprising auth edge during onboarding: rotated a project key, exported REDWOOD_API_KEY, but requests that retried still used the old token and failed.

mira: weird — did the SDK attach the token to the retry logic? we had a bug where the retryer reused the original auth header instead of re-resolving creds.

alex: yeah stacktrace shows a 401 on first attempt, retry triggered, second attempt still 401. Debug log: 
`DEBUG auth: resolved source=env REDWOOD_API_KEY=****wxyz; DEBUG retry: reusing header Authorization: Bearer ****abcd`
I changed env to new key, but retry used cached header (old token).

eng-ryan: aha — two issues colliding: 1) resolver caching of token in request-scoped header object, 2) retry flow re-sending the same header without asking resolver for fresh creds. That repros with ephemeral keys (rotating short-lived project tokens) and CI runners that update env mid-run.

cli-bot: filed redwood/sdk-cred#1100 with repro steps and logs; tag eng-runtime. Suggest change: retry should request fresh auth from resolver before each attempt; resolver should optionally skip cache when token TTL is short.

mira: proposed fix: make the HTTP client call resolver.getToken() inside retry loop rather than once per request creation. Also add a small TTL check so cached tokens are invalidated when rotation is detected (compare masked last4).

alex: small UX ask: log token source and last4 on first request and on retry failures to help triage without leaking secrets. Also add a CI test that simulates update of env between attempts to ensure retries re-resolve.

eng-ryan: doc changes: add note about ephemeral/short-lived keys and retries: either restart process after rotation or prefer server-side refresh patterns. Add CLI flag `--no-write` for CI to avoid writing creds to disk, and platform docs for macOS keychain / Windows credential manager gotchas (some sampleapps persisted old creds into OS store).

mira: I'll open PR to update the Node and Python SDKs: 1) re-resolve creds inside retry loop 2) clear cached token when env differs 3) log masked last4 on source. Add tests for retry + rotation.

alex: thanks — temporary workaround: set NEW env and restart, or unset old REDWOOD_TOKEN and ensure CI uses `--env` injection. Logged issue #1100 has repro and a tiny sample script.

cli-bot: Reminder: include tests in PR and ping @eng-runtime and @devex. Target milestone: v1.10.0.
